rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for cooked rice served as food.

example.english: I want to eat rice tonight.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use 米 for uncooked rice grains, such as rice bought or measured for cooking.

example.english: I bought some rice to cook at home.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 mai5 faan1 uk1 kei2 zyu2

rows.note: Use 白飯 specifically for plain cooked white rice rather than a rice dish.

example.english: I’m full enough just eating plain rice.
example.traditional: 我淨係食白飯都夠飽喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik6 baak6 faan6 dou1 gau3 baau2 laa3

rows.note: Use 禾 when referring to the rice plant or crop itself rather than its grain or cooked food.

example.english: The rice plants are growing beautifully this year.
example.jyutping: wo4 miu4 gam1 nin4 zoeng2 dak1 hou2 leng3
